projects.name: Forge
projects.desc: A reference-free DNA analysis pipeline that detects cancer and antibiotic resistance from raw sequencing reads — no genome alignment required.
bullets: Assembled raw reads into De Bruijn graphs and extracted 14 graph-level features for downstream classification.
Trained a GNN using GCN layers, Graph Attention, and global mean+max pooling to classify genomic patterns.
Replaced brute-force grid search with an LLM-driven parameter optimizer and added a natural language query interface.
projects.chart:
flowchart LR
  A((Raw Reads))-->B[De Bruijn Graph]
  B-->C[Feature Extraction]
  C-->D{GNN Classifier}
  D-->E[GCN Layers]
  D-->F[Graph Attention]
  E-->G[Pooling]
  F-->G
  G-->H[LLM Optimizer]
  H-->I((Prediction))

projects.name: Mini Me AI
projects.desc: A local AI assistant focused on running LLMs without relying on cloud APIs, integrating voice and real-time interaction.
bullets: Runs local LLM inference through Ollama instead of depending fully on external APIs.
Uses voice input and text-to-speech to make the assistant feel more interactive.
Connects local AI, personality behavior, and system-level constraints into one project.
projects.chart:
flowchart LR
  A((User Input))-->B[Speech / Text]
  B-->C{Input Type}
  C-->D[Local LLM]
  C-->E[System Logic]
  D-->F[Response]
  E-->F
  F-->G((Voice Output))

projects.name: Autonomous Roblox AI Agent
projects.desc: An autonomous vision-based AI agent that independently controls a Roblox character, navigating environments and completing multi-step tasks without continuous user input.
bullets: Built an autonomous vision-based AI agent capable of independently controlling a Roblox character, navigating environments, and completing multi-step tasks without continuous user input.
Integrated Gemini vision models to interpret live gameplay frames and make real-time decisions for navigation, object interaction, and purchases using in-game currency.
Developed a Discord bot for remote status monitoring and agent control, with randomized movement and interaction timing to improve behavioral robustness.

flowchart LR
  A((Game Frame))-->B[Gemini Vision Model]
  B-->C{Decision}
  C-->D[Navigation]
  C-->E[Object Interaction]
  C-->F[In-Game Purchase]
  D-->G[Character Control]
  E-->G
  F-->G
  G-->H[Discord Bot Monitor]
  H-->I((Status / Control))

research.name: Research Paper
research.desc: "Rethinking Deep Self-Attention for Character-Level Language Modeling" — a counterargument paper challenging the assumption that transformers fully replace RNNs.
bullets: Challenged the prevailing claim that deep self-attention architectures supersede recurrent networks for character-level language modeling.
Analyzed trade-offs including fixed context windows, quadratic computational cost, and long-term dependency limitations.
Proposed hybrid and sequential architectures as a more practical direction, grounded in empirical and theoretical analysis.
research.chart:
flowchart LR
  A((Claim))-->B{Evaluation}
  B-->C[Context Windows]
  B-->D[Compute Cost]
  B-->E[Long-term Deps]
  C-->F[Trade-off Analysis]
  D-->F
  E-->F
  F-->G[Hybrid Proposal]
  G-->H((Counterargument))

hackathons.name: WasteLess AI
hackathons.desc: A food redistribution platform connecting restaurants with surplus food to nearby shelters using location-based matching.
bullets: Restaurants submit extra food with location, availability, quantity, and pickup windows.
The app compares shelter needs, distance, urgency, and constraints before matching.
Map and backend data work together so the system feels practical instead of just visual.

  C-->F[Pickup Window]
  D-->G[Matching Logic]
  E-->G
  F-->G
  G-->H[Map View]
  G-->I((Shelter))

hackathons.name: ProfessorMatch
hackathons.desc: A system that ranks professors using combined datasets and explains recommendations based on student goals.
bullets: Pulls together professor ratings, course data, and profile information.
Uses ranking logic to match professors to goals like GPA, learning depth, or career value.
Shows explainable results so students understand why each professor is recommended.

hackathons.name: Roguelike Maker
hackathons.desc: A prompt-to-playable-game system where an AI generator creates JSON settings that directly change a Godot roguelike prototype.
bullets: Built a config pipeline where prompts changed player speed, enemy density, weapon type, and room sequence.
Connected the generated JSON into Godot so changing the config directly changed gameplay.
Implemented live config reloading — instant gameplay updates without restarting.
Implemented a map generation system using a 40×40 sprite to define and spawn the game layout.

  B-->E[Room Sequence]
  C-->G[JSON Config]
  D-->G
  E-->G
